{{Top|leg}}
'''Bird-moths''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] native to [[Abeloth's planet]]. They came in a dazzling array of [[Color/Legends|colors]], including red, yellow, and blue. They ranged from the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] fingernail to that of a [[Bith/Legends|Bith's]] head, and their chirping sounded like thousands of [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droids]] suffering from an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion barrage]].
